clips.title: The story
paras: The Rite of Vision is the spiritual climax of an ancient trial undertaken by young tauren in Bloodhoof Village. By drinking the sacred Water of the Seers beside the tribal bonfire, initiates summon a spectral guide to lead them toward their destiny.

After gathering the necessary ritual herbs and passing the initial trials of faith, an initiate is granted the Water of the Seers by the village shaman, Zarlman Two-Moons. This potent draught must be ingested before the roaring tribal fire at the heart of Bloodhoof Village. When consumed with a focused and respectful mind, the sacred waters expand the drinker's perception beyond physical sight, bridging the veil between the material plane and the spiritual realm.

Upon drinking the brew, the flames yield an ethereal apparition: an ancestral ghost wolf. The spirit does not speak or fight, but silently lopes northwest across the rolling plains of Mulgore. A true initiate must heed its quiet path, tracking its journey away from the village and deep into the rocky hills where the hermit Seer Wiserunner awaits in secluded meditation.

Reaching Seer Wiserunner at the mouth of his mountain cavern signifies the successful completion of the vision. This journey across the grassy hills tests an initiate's patience, trust in ancestral guidance, and attunement to the Earth Mother. Passing this rite grants the young adventurer the right to undergo the ultimate test of adulthood: the Rite of Wisdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I now present you with the Water of the Seers.
When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.
At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be not afraid, friend. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
